headline: Amgen (AMGN) Stock Still Looks Below Fair Value Today
summary: Amgen stock has nearly doubled investors' money over the past five years, yet current checks suggest a mixed picture where the Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) intrinsic value points to meaningful upside while market multiples look closer to fair. Amgen has delivered a 93.9% return over five years, which puts more focus on whether the current share price still leaves room relative to intrinsic value estimates. headline: Amgen (AMGN) Wins Backing In Europe For Broader Repatha Use
summary: Amgen (NasdaqGS:AMGN) received a positive opinion from the European Medicines Agency’s CHMP for an expanded Repatha indication in Europe. The recommendation covers use of Repatha to help reduce cardiovascular risk in high risk adults without a prior heart attack or stroke. The CHMP view is based on Phase 3 clinical data that showed a significant reduction in major adverse cardiovascular events. Amgen is a large biotech company with a focus on cardiometabolic, oncology and immunology...
